name: ad-traffic
title_zh: 广告花费先看哪笔在烧钱不产单的跨境投手
tagline_zh: ACOS 高不急着降竞价，先拆流量结构找出浪费点。能告诉你否定词该加在哪一层。
tagline_en: High ACOS? Don't cut bids blindly. It breaks down spend by keyword & placement to show where money leaks, then.
desc_en: 跨境电商广告与流量分析。当用户问「广告效果」「ACOS」「CPC」「流量来源」「预算怎么分配」「怎么降 ACOS」时使用。分析流量结构、广告花费与转化效率，定位浪费点，给出竞价、预算、结构与否定词的优化建议。
why_zh: 它不只看 ACOS 数字，而是把花费拆到关键词和 placement 粒度。
why_en: Goes beyond surface ACOS to isolate waste at keyword and placement level, then gives concrete bid, structure, and.
limit_zh: 只覆盖亚马逊广告（SP/SB/SD）和站内流量分析，不处理 TikTok/Facebook 等站外投放。
limit_en: Amazon ads (SP/SB/SD) & on-site traffic only; no off-platform channels. Needs API access or exported reports. Advice stops at actions, no execution.
title_en: Amazon ad spend analyzer that finds burning budget before.
